features.name: Input Validation for Workflows
features.description: Enhanced input validation in AL-Go workflows, specifically for create release and increment version number workflows. The system now fails early if invalid parameters are provided instead of failing at the end of execution.
caveats: Currently only for create release and increment version number workflows
More workflows will be improved over time

features.name: AL-Go Settings Schema Property
features.description: A schema property added to the AL-Go file that provides VS Code suggestions when editing settings and validates settings against the schema to ensure correct syntax and setup.
features.status_evidence_quote: If you're on preview, you might already see it. Otherwise, you'll have to wait for the 7.2

features.name: Fail Pull Requests on New Warnings
features.description: A feature that automatically fails pull requests if they introduce new code warnings, forcing developers to fix warnings before merging. Looks at new warnings only so users with existing codebases do not have to fix all warnings.
features.status_evidence_quote: Right now it's in preview. Uh I don't know if we have any. We'll ship 7.2 soon
caveats: Can be switched on or off with settings
Does not change CI/CD error behavior

features.name: BC Container Helper Deprecation Notice
features.description: BC Container Helper versions earlier than 6.1 no longer work. Container Helper is scheduled to be deprecated in about two years, with functionality being replaced by new modules.
caveats: Affects users spinning up local containers
BC Container Helper deprecation timeline not specified

features.name: AL-Go Version Support Update
features.description: Announcement that AL-Go system file versions 5.0 and lower will stop working. Version 5.0 is approximately one year old.
caveats: Version 5.0 is about one year old
Users should update system files regularly

features.name: Page Scripting Tests on SaaS Environments
features.description: Page scripting feature in SaaS is being worked on. Currently unable to run page scripting tests on SaaS environments due to 2FA or MFA requirements, but this is being addressed.

features.name: Azure DevOps and GitHub Integration
features.description: Azure Boards integration allows referencing work items from GitHub and creates automatic links between Azure DevOps and GitHub. Microsoft uses this approach internally alongside AL-Go.
caveats: Custom automation may be needed beyond standard integration

features.name: Data-Driven Testing Support
features.description: AL-Go currently has no support for data-driven testing. The new AI test toolkit exists but integration with AL-Go has not been implemented yet.

features.name: GitHub Copilot Code Review for AL
features.description: GitHub Copilot has a code review feature but is not yet effective for AL language. Improvement needed to make Copilot capable of actual code reviews and formatting for AL.
caveats: Not yet effective for AL language
Needs work on code review and formatting capabilities

features.name: Building Runtime Packages in AL-Go
features.description: Building runtime packages is not supported by AL-Go and remains on the backlog for future implementation.

features.name: Auto Translation Feature
features.description: Translation functionality for AL-Go pipelines. Community has requested this feature multiple times. Status remains unclear with no recent progress or timeline.

features.name: Incremental Builds Feature
features.description: Feature related to incremental compilation in AL-Go builds that was suggested at a round table discussion at Directions. The biggest feature outcome from that round table discussion.

features.name: GitHub Discussions Ideas Tab
features.description: Feature using GitHub Discussions to gather and evaluate new feature ideas for AL-Go backlog. Users can vote or upvote ideas to indicate priority and impact.

features.name: Artifact URL Migration to Front Door
features.description: AL-Go is migrating artifact URLs from direct storage account access to going through a front door. Old URLs like bc-artifacts.blob.storage.net will no longer work; new URLs will use bc-artifacts slash with different structure. This is part of a Microsoft security push.
caveats: End of June deadline for migration
BC Container Helper would previously auto-translate URLs

features.name: AL-Go Independence from BC Container Helper
features.description: AL-Go is working toward becoming fully independent of BC Container Helper. Currently AL-Go still has dependencies on BC Container Helper and needs to extract needed functionality before BC Container Helper is deprecated.

features.name: AL-Go GitHub Project Ongoing Support
features.description: Microsoft team will continue working on AL-Go with consistent resource allocation despite staffing changes. Sebastian has been added to the team to maintain project momentum.
caveats: Resource allocation details not publicly disclosed

features.name: Engineering Systems Team Oversight
features.description: AL-Go project falls under the engineering systems team. Yonas is the Microsoft manager with responsibility for the project, supported by team members Maria and others.
